author: Athena++ collaboration
title: Athena++ official field_loop and orszag_tang problem generators, pinned source
role: Actually inspected independent engine and fixed initial conditions; finite-grid numerical reference only
review_level: Official archive SHA verified; selected src/pgen/field_loop.cpp and orszag_tang.cpp, PLM/RK2/output configuration and actual conserved tab headers inspected; not a full Athena code audit

review.ja: 固定コミットの公式アーカイブSHAを照合し、2初期値生成器と設定・保存列を確認。別実装を実行して参照場を作成し、空間・時間感度を検査。全ソース監査や厳密解とは表示しません。
review.en: Verified the official pinned archive SHA and inspected both generators, configuration and saved columns. Executed the independent engine and checked spatial/time sensitivity. No complete code audit or exact-solution claim.

author: Thomas A. Gardiner and James M. Stone
title: An unsplit Godunov method for ideal MHD via constrained transport
role: Primary CT-contact, magnetic-loop and circular-polarization background; selected sections only
review_level: Author arXiv PDF selected section2.2 equations13–20,3.3.1–3.3.2 and5.1–5.2 inspected; not the full paper or original experiment replication

review.ja: 著者公開PDFのCT節・磁場ループ・円偏波の定義を確認。論文のCTU/PPMや斜め伝播実験を再現したとは主張しません。今回の円偏波は1次元整列、公式磁場ループはvz=2の明示的変更です。
review.en: Inspected the author PDF CT section and loop/polarized-wave definitions. Original CTU/PPM and oblique-wave experiments are not replicated. Our wave is 1D aligned; the official loop generator explicitly has vz=2.

author: Takahiro Miyoshi and Kanya Kusano
title: A multi-state HLL approximate Riemann solver for ideal magnetohydrodynamics
role: Original HLLD attribution; implementation inherited from previously validated Atlas source
review_level: Bibliographic metadata checked; publisher full text returned403. This addition did not newly audit original equations or experiments

review.ja: 書誌を確認。出版社本文は取得できず、今回新たに原著の式や実験を監査したとは表示しません。全8変数HLLDコードは過去の公開検証済みAtlasから同一バイトで継承します。
review.en: Bibliographic metadata checked; full publisher text unavailable. No new original-equation/experiment audit is claimed. Full-state HLLD is inherited byte-for-byte from the prior public validated Atlas.

author: Steven A. Orszag and Ching-Mao Tang
title: Small-scale structure of two-dimensional magnetohydrodynamic turbulence
role: Historical attribution, not a reference table for this compressible ideal-MHD calculation
review_level: Original publisher abstract/bibliography inspected only; original incompressible viscous/resistive setup differs from the official compressible ideal-MHD generator used here

review.ja: 出版社の抄録と書誌のみ確認。原著の非圧縮・粘性抵抗モデルと、今回の圧縮性理想MHDの公式初期値を区別します。
review.en: Inspected publisher abstract and bibliography only. Distinguish the original incompressible viscous/resistive study from the official compressible ideal-MHD setup used here.
